refused.module_needs_choice: Several modules can provide “{capability}” ({candidates}). Pick one with --choose {capability}=<module>.
refused.module_needs_confirmation: This also removes the modules that depend on it: {cascade}.
refused.module_conflict: Only one module can provide “{capability}” at a time ({modules}). Use --replace to replace the current one.
refused.module_unsatisfiable: “{module}” needs “{capability}”, which no module in the catalogue provides.
refused.module_unknown: There is no module called “{module}” in the catalogue.
refused.module_cycle: These modules depend on each other and cannot be installed: {modules}.
refused.module_busy: Another module operation is running. Try again when it is finished.
refused.model_unknown: There is no connected model called “{name}”.
refused.model_gateway_failed: The model gateway did not accept this change, so nothing was changed. Check the key, then try again.

code.up_failed: the module could not be started
code.down_failed: the module could not be stopped
code.unhealthy: the module started but did not become healthy in time
code.hook_failed: a setup step of the module failed
code.compose_rejected: the module breaks a platform rule and was refused
code.no_compatible_variant: the module does not fit this machine
code.render_failed: the module description could not be read
code.module_missing: the module disappeared during the operation
code.decrypt_failed: a stored secret could not be read
code.unknown_key_version: a stored secret was written with a key that is no longer available
code.route_failed: the module runs but its web address could not be published
code.llm_failed: the module runs but the language-model gateway did not accept its models
code.internal_error: an unexpected error occurred; nothing was left half installed

plan.title: This will:
plan.auto_added: Also installed because they are needed: {modules}
plan.auto_removed: Also removed because nothing needs them any more: {modules}

modules.question: Go ahead?
modules.nothing_to_do: Nothing to do: the modules are already in the requested state.
modules.working: Working… this can take several minutes (images and models are downloaded).
modules.rolled_back: Rolled back: {modules}. Nothing was left half installed.
modules.partial: Some removals had already been done before the failure.
modules.still_running: Still running after an hour (operation {id}). It continues in the background: check with cobble modules list.
modules.unavailable: The module-manager is not running or does not answer.

pack.unknown: There is no starter pack called “{pack}”. See: cobble modules packs
pack.nothing: Name at least one module, or choose a starter pack with --pack.
pack.no_fit: The pack “{pack}” does not fit this machine ({problems}).
pack.ignored: The pack “{pack}” is not usable and was ignored: {problems}

models.empty: No model service is connected. The built-in demo model answers.
models.removed: “{name}” was removed; its key was deleted.
models.working: Connecting… the model gateway restarts, this takes about 20 seconds.

test.auth_failed: refused the key. Check that it is correct and has not expired.
test.model_not_found: does not know this model name. Check the spelling.
test.rate_limited: refused because of a limit or a missing balance on your account.
test.unreachable: cannot be reached. Check the address and the network.
